question: What was the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of Luxembourg's exports by HS2 chapter in 2005 and in 2025?

assumptions: Herfindahl-Hirschman index interpreted as a single value summarizing export concentration by HS2 chapter
Herfindahl-Hirschman index interpreted as a single value summarizing export concentration by HS2 chapter
Herfindahl-Hirschman index interpreted as a single value summarizing export concentration by HS2 chapter

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.

sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  WITH exports_2005 AS (
    SELECT
      hs2,
      SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur
    FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
    WHERE
      flow = 'export' AND year = 2005
    GROUP BY
      hs2
  ), exports_2025 AS (
    SELECT
      hs2,
      SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur
    FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
    WHERE
      flow = 'export' AND year = 2025
    GROUP BY
      hs2
  ), total_2005 AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(value_eur) AS total_value
    FROM exports_2005
  ), total_2025 AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(value_eur) AS total_value
    FROM exports_2025
  ), hhi_2005 AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(POWER(value_eur / (
        SELECT
          total_value
        FROM total_2005
      ), 2)) AS hhi
    FROM exports_2005
  ), hhi_2025 AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(POWER(value_eur / (
        SELECT
          total_value
        FROM total_2025
      ), 2)) AS hhi
    FROM exports_2025
  )
  SELECT
    2005 AS year,
    hhi AS herfindahl_hirschman_index
  FROM hhi_2005
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    2025 AS year,
    hhi AS herfindahl_hirschman_index
  FROM hhi_2025
  LIMIT 1000
) AS u
LIMIT 10000
title: This query calculates the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI) of Luxembourg's exports by HS2
insight: This query calculates the Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI) of Luxembourg's exports by HS2 chapter for the years 2005 and 2025, measuring export concentration by summing the squared market shares of each HS2 chapter in total exports for those years.
